Since the [[Battle of Jakku]], which ended the war between the New Republic and the Empire, took place in [[5 ABY]], this last subchapter must take place in [[11 ABY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: Alphabet Squadron]]'' |preceded by=''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]'' |followed by= }} '''''Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Alexander Freed]]. It is the sequel to ''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel|Shadow Fall]]'' ([[2020]]) and the final volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Alphabet Squadron]]'' trilogy. It was published by [[Del Rey]] on [[March 2]], [[2021]]. The [[Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel (audiobook)|''Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel'' audiobook]] was narrated by [[January LaVoy]].
